report.method: Seven Oklab lightness slices; 24 hues at 15 degree steps; eight chroma levels 0..0.25 inclusive. Clamp out-of-range sRGB channels to reproduce supplied screenshot colors. Deduplicate byte colors, keep black/white, grow a farthest-point grid subset at ΔE00 >= 2, then fill exclusively from OKHSV Sketch at the same hard threshold.
report.interpretation: Eight rings includes C=0. Every zero-chroma ring repeats the same gray 24 times before deduplication. Requested lightness/chroma/hue are construction coordinates; clipping changes final Oklab values. The unknown viewer implementation is inferred from matching RGB readouts, not claimed recovered.
report.selection_note: Deterministic maximin heuristic with grid priority among eligible colors. A maximal grid subset is not a proof of maximum cardinality or optimal coverage. Every omitted grid color is less than 2 ΔE00 from a retained grid-stage color.
